title: Vortex Neo 12 5G (Aurora Blue, 128 GB) (6 GB RAM)

sections.description: The Vortex Neo 12 5G is built for people who never want to worry about charging. Its huge 6000 mAh battery keeps going for up to two days of normal use. The 6.6 inch FHD+ display with a 90Hz refresh rate makes scrolling smooth, and the 64 MP AI camera captures bright, colourful photos in daylight. With the Vortex V5 octa-core processor and 6 GB RAM (plus up to 6 GB virtual RAM), everyday apps run smoothly.

reviews: 5 ★ Battery king. Charged it on Monday morning and it lasted till Tuesday night with normal use. Best battery I have ever had in a phone.
4 ★ Good phone for the price. Smooth for daily use, the 90Hz screen is nice. Camera is good in daylight. Only complaint is the slow charging.
2 ★ Charging is very slow. The box only has a 10W charger, so a full charge takes almost 3 hours. You need to buy an 18W charger separately to get the advertised speed.
5 ★ Value for money. Got it for 14,499 in the Big Billion Days sale. Battery, display and performance are all good for this price.
3 ★ Display is just okay. It is an LCD panel, so blacks look greyish and viewing angles are not great. Brightness is fine indoors but weak in sunlight.
4 ★ Camera is decent. The 64MP camera takes good photos in daylight with nice colours. Low-light photos are soft and a bit noisy.
1 ★ Very heavy and thick. At 205 grams it hurts my wrist while lying down and watching videos. Wish they had made it slimmer.
5 ★ Perfect for my mother. She mainly uses WhatsApp and YouTube, and she charges it only every two days. The headphone jack is a plus for her.
3 ★ Gaming performance is average. BGMI runs only on smooth graphics with occasional lag. Good for casual games, not for serious gaming.
4 ★ Nice design. The Aurora Blue colour looks beautiful and changes shade in light. Fingerprint sensor on the side is fast and accurate.
2 ★ Software updates are slow. It still has an older security patch and Vortex has not said how many Android updates it will get.
5 ★ Great standby time. Overnight it loses only 1 to 2 percent. I travel a lot and the battery gives me peace of mind.
4 ★ Loud single speaker. There is only one speaker at the bottom, but it is quite loud. Fine for calls on speaker and videos.
3 ★ Selfie camera is average. The 8MP front camera is okay for video calls but selfies look soft and dull indoors.
4 ★ Good 5G speeds. Airtel 5G works well in my city. Battery does not drain much even on 5G. Overall a good budget phone.
